positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
Courses turtored:  
- CS136|Elementary Algorithm Design and Data Abstraction - a 1st year CS major course 
- CS246|Object-Oriented Software Development - a 2nd year CS major course 
- CS350|Operating System - a 3rd year CS major course

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Implemented Nessie, a low-latency lock-free distributed hash table 
using RDMA(Remote Direct Memory Access) - 10K+ LOC in C++
- Achieved average latency(<10us) ten times faster than traditional TCP/IP based systems.

Paper published on IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems (TPDS) :
http://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/7987083/
PDF: https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/~becassel/common/publications/cassell2017nessie.pdf

company.name: University of Waterloo - Shoshin Distributed System Lab

positions.title: University of Waterloo- Research Assistant(Part-time)
positions.description:
- Tested and optimized CrossStitch, a transaction processing framework for web applications.
- Reduced the average abort rate and latency by more than 90% for skewed workload and more than
50% for common workload by optimizing the concurrency control flow.
- Tested the system on Amazon EC2 with more than 50 instances.
